paragraphs: Async screen and camera recording for teams, built to protect every take from crashes and dropped connections. The product name lives in apps/web/src/lib/brand.ts and apps/mobile/app.json. Internal identifiers (database name, browser storage keys) still say framecast on purpose: renaming them would orphan keys and recordings already saved in browsers.
